description: This file defines the OX_Maintenance class, which provides methods for running maintenance tasks in the Revive Adserver project, including scheduled maintenance, midnight tasks, report sending, data pruning, and synchronization.

classes.name: OX_Maintenance
classes.description: A class providing methods for scheduled maintenance, including running statistics, pruning, report sending, and synchronization tasks.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes configuration, loads preferences, and establishes database connection.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method to execute maintenance tasks, including acquiring lock, running statistics, midnight tasks, and sync.

methods.name: getLastRun
methods.description: Returns the last time maintenance was run.

methods.name: getLastScheduledRun
methods.description: Returns the last scheduled maintenance run time.

methods.name: isMidnightMaintenance
methods.description: Checks if midnight maintenance tasks should run based on last run time.

methods.name: _runMidnightTasks
methods.description: Executes midnight maintenance tasks such as reports and pruning.

methods.name: _runReports
methods.description: Sends campaign delivery reports to advertisers based on report intervals.

methods.name: _runGeneralPruning
methods.description: Prunes old data from logs and statistics tables based on configured retention period.

methods.name: updateLastRun
methods.description: Updates the last run timestamp for maintenance or scheduled tasks.
